context.title: San Diego Deputy Sheriffs Association: positions from signed ballot arguments, 2026-11-03 California general election

subject.title: San Diego County — Measure A (A Transparent, Accountable, Modern County Government)

positions.statement: Mike O’Deane (President, San Diego Deputy Sheriffs Association) signed the argument in favor of San Diego County Measure A in the San Diego County Voter Information Pamphlets.
